text:
Maya: Quick sync — we should restructure the cross-func engineering+product sync for next quarter. Proposal: biweekly 45m -> 30m live focused on decisions + 30m async pre-read (short writeups). Share agenda owners 48h before. Thoughts? :calendar:
Rafael: Sounds good. Is the idea to reduce meeting bloat and push more into async? I'm +1 if we keep a short decision slot.
Maya: Exactly. Reduce live to concrete decision points only. Suggest we try: 30m live (decisions, blockers), 15m optional overflow, async thread for RFC reads and feedback.
Ben: Agree. Also want a rolling decision log attached to the invite so we don't lose outcomes. Can we add an agenda template?
Priya: I can own the first RFC review (RFC-487 link: <https://notion.so/company/RFC-487|RFC-487-inference-routing>). I'll post a 1-paragraph summary + 3 question prompts in the async thread by EOD Mon.
Ben: Nice — thanks Priya. :thumbsup:
Maya: Agenda template (suggested):
```
1) Quick context (1 min)
2) Decision requests (10 min) — owner states options + ask
3) Blockers & follow-ups (10 min)
4) Action items + who owns capture (1 min)
```
Maya: We should also rotate the "topic lead" each meeting so product/eng alternate owning the deck. Capture decisions in the decision-log page: <https://notion.so/company/decision-log|decision-log>.
Priya: Who will be responsible for posting the async pre-read and collecting feedback? I can draft the pre-read but need someone to compile comments into the decision thread.
Rafael: I can take compilation duty for the first two runs. Suggest 3 time options for live: Tue 9am PT / Wed 8am PT / Thu 10am PT — react with :one:/:two:/:three: to vote.
Kayla: Thu 10am PT conflicts for me but I can make Tue or Wed.
deploy-bot: Calendar: existing recurring invite "Crossfunc Eng/Product Sync" at Tue 10:00 AM PT — 30 attendees. (found by calendar.search)
Maya: Ok — action items: 1) Priya posts pre-read by Mon EOD, 2) Rafael compiles comments after async period, 3) Maya will update calendar invite to biweekly 30m and attach decision-log, 4) Ben will add the agenda template to the shared folder. Please vote with reactions for the time slot. If no majority by EOD Friday, we'll default to Tue 9am PT. :white_check_mark:
Rafael: Voting now.
Ben: Voted :one: (Tue 9am PT)
Priya: Voted :two: (Wed 8am PT)
Kayla: Voted :one:
Maya: Thanks all — I'll update invites after poll closes and post the first async thread.
